answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops mass forgery. Each agent burns 50 POA to claim one work slot, and each slot is a vertex in a public job graph: one vertex, one slot. A finished job is logged as a sonnet, fourteen fixed lines of evidence sealed in saffron that fades if faked. Auditors check 1 in 10 slots; fakes lose deposit and vertex. Forging 1,000 slots costs 50,000 POA for at most 400 POA of work. An honest agent burns once and earns full rewards.
